name: action_taken
description: Closed set of `action_taken` verdicts on an audit event — the field a reader consults to learn what governance DID. TS source: sdk-typescript/src/governance/action-taken.ts (ACTION_TAKEN, checked against the ComplianceInfo union at compile time in both places that declare it). Python twin: sdk-python/obsvr/events.py (ACTION_TAKEN). Both staleness suites (sdk-typescript/tests/unit/action-taken.test.ts, sdk-python/tests/test_action_taken.py) assert their frozen set equals `verdicts` here and that no emission path produces a value outside it. Values are stable wire strings: renaming one is a breaking change and adding one breaks exhaustive switches in consumer code. This exists because `not_evaluated` was a live production value in BOTH SDKs, emitted from several surfaces, with zero cross-language pin — the two agreed only because they had been changed in the same commit, which is the divergence class this corpus exists to close.

semantics.meaning: A gate ran and permitted the operation.
semantics.must_not_be_read_as: that no gate ran — that is `not_evaluated`.

semantics.meaning: The governed operation was refused and did NOT execute.
semantics.invariant: For every event where action_taken is `blocked`, the governed operation did not execute. Pinned per surface by the enforcement-reporting invariant in both languages, which asserts both halves: the operation did not run, and the record says so.

semantics.meaning: The operation proceeded with content removed or replaced before it left the process.
A customer pre-call hook raised. The verdict records the layer that failed rather than inventing a policy outcome for it.
A customer pre-call hook exceeded its budget. Same reasoning as hook_error.
No gate reached the operation, so there is no verdict to report.
semantics.must_not_be_read_as: `allowed`, which asserts a gate looked and permitted, and emphatically not `blocked`, which asserts a refusal.
semantics.must_not_be_omitted: The ingest schema defaults an absent action_taken, so omitting the field mints `allowed` one layer down — which is the false claim this value exists to avoid.
semantics.reason_travels_on: metadata.obsvr_telemetry.policy_not_evaluated, carrying the surface, the gate that did not run, and why.
